title: Logic Programming, SMT/SAT, and Equality-Saturation Source Identities

sources.notes: Souffle source identity for Datalog-style logic-defined static analysis, large-scale analysis problems, points-to analysis, taint analysis, security checks, and translation to parallel C++; documentation bodies and code remain license-reviewed before extraction.

Souffle tutorial identity for Datalog as a declarative logic-based query language supporting recursive queries and applications in program analysis, security, graph databases, and declarative networking; examples and page body remain boundary-checked.

SMT-LIB standard identity for Satisfiability Modulo Theories, common input/output languages, theory/logics specifications, benchmarks, solver tools, and semantics documents; standards documents and benchmarks remain boundary-checked.

Z3 repository identity for the Microsoft Research theorem prover, MIT-licensed source, language bindings, releases, and Z3 Guide link; repository code, docs, images, binaries, and examples remain boundary-checked.
Microsoft Z3 Guide identity for user-facing solver documentation; guide body, examples, generated API docs, packages, and linked assets remain boundary-checked.

SAT Competition 2024 identity for competitive SAT solver evaluation, benchmarks, solver tracks, results, metadata, and proceedings; downloads, solver sources, benchmarks, proceedings, and slides remain boundary-checked.

Egraphs-good project identity for egg and egglog, e-graphs, equality saturation, program optimizers, synthesizers, Datalog-based e-graph systems, and community resources; docs, demos, papers, and code remain boundary-checked.

egg Rust API documentation identity for an e-graph library optimized for equality saturation, tutorials, rewrite rules, runner/extractor workflow, and paper link; generated docs and examples remain boundary-checked.
egglog tutorial identity for equality saturation using rewrite rules and e-graphs, including extraction and checks; tutorial text, examples, demos, and code remain boundary-checked.

Cornell equality-saturation paper page identity for optimization as equality analysis over a common IR, saturation, profitability extraction, and translation validation; paper PDF and page body remain boundary-checked.

arXiv identity for egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation, describing e-graphs, congruence relations, equality saturation, rebuilding, e-class analyses, and compiler optimization use cases; PDF and source remain boundary-checked.
